headers.name: Parle-Client-Name
headers.description: Validated canonical identifier for the Parle-aware component that owns request and session lifecycle.

headers.name: Parle-Client-Version
headers.description: Validated opaque release token for the client component; valid only with a valid client name.

headers.name: Parle-Integration-Name
headers.description: Validated canonical identifier for the optional outer application, plugin, extension, or adapter that configures or launches the client.

headers.name: Parle-Integration-Version
headers.description: Validated opaque release token for the integration; valid only with a valid integration name.

invalid_behavior: omit invalid fields; require each version to have a valid corresponding name; set client_metadata_invalid or integration_metadata_invalid for the affected pair; preserve response behavior
authorization_use: diagnostic only; never authorization, moderation, limits, quotas, or trust
